task: Develop a unified deep learning framework for protein sequences, nucleic acid sequences, and small molecule structures that outputs accurate 3D structures of biomolecular complexes using a diffusion-based architecture.
named_method_commitments: unified multimodal inputs: protein, nucleic acid, small molecule
evaluation on available FKBP12/FK506 sample ground-truth structures
AlphaFold 3 context/comparison where feasible from related work and available data
available_primary_data: data/sample/2l3r/2l3r_protein.pdb: FKBP12 CA-only NMR structure, 107 residues
implementation_scope_decision: The workspace provides only one protein CA-only structure and one ligand SDF, no training corpus or AlphaFold 3 predictions. Therefore the deliverable will be a faithful framework design plus an executable prototype/evaluation harness: data parsing, complex feature construction, diffusion architecture specification, baseline/proxy structure validation, and figures grounded in the supplied structures.
primary_outputs: data-derived metrics and framework artifacts in outputs/
